node.title: Full generic pair projection survives guarded anchors at unchanged cost
node.statement: For W subset V x V of dimensions r,s with s<r<=2s and full generic projection, a bad set of scalar evaluation span<=2s-r and cardinality<=K+s-r can be removed so every remaining joint section has dimensions r-2,s-1 and full generic projection. Weighted incidence retains factor(n-K-s+r)/(A-K-s+r). Joint rank two alone does not preserve regularity; an F101 example shows strict loss. A square regular c/c terminal is an original-field operator graph when |F|>c. No actual-span fullness, terminal weight bound or Prize closure is asserted.
